So recently I started smoking through a water rig I had used as a converted dab rig in the past. And I noticed my exhale smoke has a waxy smell to it. Like I just dabbed, but clearly I was smoking flower.

I have cleaned it in the past with alcohol and salt so its totally clean, as well as replaced the down stem.

My concern (hypothesis) is this - If I was smoking wax though the water rig, it has contaminated it , and even though I may be smoking flower, I am still getting waxy residues left on the inner glass base.

Tests - Different flowers smoked through the unit still will produce a "waxy" undertone through out the air. Unit has been cleaned with 91% iso alcohol and rock salt multiple times, and was last used as a dab rig approx. 12 - 16 months ago. Downstem has been replaced. (Second one in use now.) Bowl has not has any wax smoked through it. (hybrid or glazed bowl) Unit breaks down into two pieces. mouth piece, and base. (Possible contaminated pieces.)

Conclusion - Unit is contaminated with bho residues and will be required to be replaced with a completely new water unit.

Has anyone else experienced a situation where your water rig produces a waxy smell/ exhale, although you are smoking flower through it ?
